=== Section 7: the strip prime ell in (b/4,b/2) for large b (modular only) ===
For each b: ell = a prime in (b/4,b/2) (Bertrand), J = {j in {2,3}: j*ell in [a,b]},
S = sum_{j in J} 1/j (exact fraction), T_ell = S mod ell. Expect J nonempty, T != 0.
